about_the_game: In this DLC for Oktyabrsk-21, you’ll encounter Mikhail Grigoryevich, a former "Red October" engineer, standing by a house №11 on Academic Street. His tale weaves nostalgia for the project’s early days, dark hints about a friend’s disappearance, and a local legend of the "Shadow of October." The dialogue immerses you in the city’s lore, revealing its past through dreams and intrigues, yet leaves the main storyline untouched. Discover– Discover what Oktyabrsk-21 hides and feel its unique atmosphere. Perfect for those craving more stories about the mysterious city and its secrets.
